label: Closed-collection rootedness of actual grounding
definition: Over the #505 Profile, a collection S of candidates is ground-closed at w (GroundClosedActual m w S) when every member of S is an actual concretum at w and every actual concrete ground at w of a member of S is itself in S. ClosedGroundingCollectionsRooted m w holds when no ground-closed collection is both nonempty and without an actual root (ActualRoot: an actual concretum with no actual concrete ground at w); in Lean, every ground-closed collection all of whose members have an actual concrete ground is empty. Ordinary meaning: if you collect actual things together with everything that actually gives being to any of them, and keep doing so, the collection must contain something to which no actual thing gives being. Orientation example (not warrant): a lamp lit by a wire powered by a generator turned by a falling river; collecting each supplier of each member, the collection is rooted only if it reaches something nothing in it supplies. Counterexamples to the condition (formal only): a pure endless descent n+1 grounds n (Control.pureRegress) and a pure cycle with nothing outside it. Non-counterexamples: an endless descending chain all of whose members are also grounded by one root (Control.limitGrounder), and a cycle grounded by a root (Control.rootedCycle). Distinguished from well-foundedness (STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF), which says every nonempty collection, closed or not, has a member with no ground inside it: well-foundedness implies the condition (closedRootedOfWF) but not conversely. Distinguished from asymmetry (no two actual concreta ground each other), which it does not imply, and from the existence of some actual root, which it implies only with inhabitedness and excluded middle (actualRootOfClosedRooted). Structural properties: it imposes no transitivity, asymmetry, irreflexivity or finite-path condition on grounding.
note: Analyst framework definition, attribution deferred (#310). It is the dependence-transmission ('borrowed reality') condition in its weakest form that the stage-one join of the modal spine consumes: a collection each of whose members has its being only from members has a member whose being is from no actual concretum. It is relative to the profile's selected relation, which is not identified with efficient causing (DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT); whether any real relation satisfies it is open. Dependencies: DEF-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF for ActualConcrete, the ActualConcreteGround and ActualRoot predicates of the brute-root vocabulary. Generalizing from ordinary supply chains (which end in a finite number of steps) to metaphysical sustaining is an explicit open bridge. A sourced reading (Aquinas's reduction of what is by participation to what is by essence; Cameron 2008 on foundations reachable through infinitely many intermediaries) is an unread lead, not an attribution.
